\(4x + 5y \ge 20\)
\(2x + y \le 12\)
\(x,\ y \ge 0\)

A total of 60 vouchers were given on the day. The number of ₹ 1,000 vouchers added to 3 times the number of ₹ 500 vouchers, gives 100.

Express the given information as a system of linear equations in two variables. Hence, find the number of vouchers of each type by matrix method.
rows.figure: DECORATIVE — a clip-art collage of nine gift vouchers ('30% discount', 'SAVE 50$', '70% off', 'DISCOUNT 50%', promo codes).
